summary.text: David Huddleston was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2022 and represents District 72, covering parts of Carroll, Heard and Troup counties.

paragraphs.text: Huddleston is a fifth-generation farmer who lives in Roopville and operates a cow-calf operation, chicken houses, hayfields and beehives with his son.
Huddleston retired after 36 years with Carroll Electric Cooperative.
